questions.stem: What comes next in the series? A, C, F, J, O, ?

options.option_text: T (differences: +2,+3,+4,+5,+6 → O is 15th; next = 15+6=21 = U)

questions.explanation: B is correct. Position values: A=1, C=3, F=6, J=10, O=15. Differences: 2, 3, 4, 5 (increasing by 1 each time). Next difference = 6. Next position = 15+6 = 21 = U. This is the triangular number sequence (1,3,6,10,15,21...) mapped onto the alphabet.

questions.stem: Which letter is exactly in the middle between the 6th letter from the left and the 8th letter from the right in the English alphabet?

options.option_text: M (6th from left = F; 8th from right = position 26-8+1 = 19 = S; middle of F(6) and S(19) = (6+19)/2 = 12.5 — not integer)
L (positions 6 and 19; midpoint = 12.5; not exactly an integer position)
N (positions 6 and 22: 8th from right = 26-8+1 = 19 = S; (6+19)/2 = 12.5 — checking again)
M or L (no exact middle between F(6th) and S(19th); positions are 6 and 19 which don't have an integer midpoint — answer is between L and M)

questions.explanation: D is correct by analysis. 6th letter from left = F (position 6). 8th letter from right = position 26−8+1 = 19 = S. Middle position = (6+19)/2 = 12.5 — this falls between positions 12 (L) and 13 (M). Therefore there is no single letter exactly in the middle, and the question would be ambiguous in a real exam. The closest is L (position 12) or M (position 13). In most exam contexts, they round down to L or up to M.

45 (not correct by summation)

SVDDES (wrong — double-shifting some letters)
QTAAQD (shifting backward by 1)
TYDDGT (shifting forward by 2)

questions.explanation: A is correct. Verify the code: P→Q(+1), E→F(+1), N→O(+1), C→D(+1), I→J(+1)... wait: PENCIL→QFODKM. P(16)→Q(17)+1; E(5)→F(6)+1; N(14)→O(15)+1; C(3)→D(4)+1; I(9)→J(10)+1; L(12)→M(13)+1. Yes, each letter +1. RUBBER: R+1=S, U+1=V, B+1=C, B+1=C, E+1=F, R+1=S → SVCCFS.

questions.stem: How many letters in the English alphabet are there between M and T (not counting M and T)?

options.option_text: 5 (N,O,P,Q,R,S — that's 6 letters between M(13) and T(20))
6 (N=14, O=15, P=16, Q=17, R=18, S=19 — six letters between M and T exclusive)
7 (including either M or T)
8 (including both M and T)

questions.explanation: B is correct. M is the 13th letter, T is the 20th letter. Letters between them (exclusive): N(14), O(15), P(16), Q(17), R(18), S(19) — 6 letters. Formula: number of letters between position a and b (exclusive) = b − a − 1 = 20 − 13 − 1 = 6.

questions.stem: Find the missing term in the letter series: B, E, H, K, ?, Q

options.option_text: M (B=2,E=5,H=8,K=11,N=14,Q=17 — differences all +3; missing=N not M)
L (would give a +3 difference from K=11 only if L=12 — but 12-11=1≠3)

questions.explanation: B is correct. Letter positions: B=2, E=5, H=8, K=11, N=14, Q=17. Constant difference = 3 between each letter. Missing = N (14th letter). Verify: K(11)+3=14=N; N(14)+3=17=Q ✓.

questions.stem: Which letter will be the 4th to the right of the 12th letter from the right end of the English alphabet?

options.option_text: O (12th from right = position 26−12+1=15=O; 4th to right of O = O+4=position 19=S; not O)
S (12th from right = O(15); 4th to right = O+4=S(19) ✓)
R (O+3=R; 3rd to right, not 4th)
K (12th from right position 15, going 4 to the LEFT gives K=11; that's left not right)

questions.explanation: B is correct. 12th letter from the RIGHT: position from left = 26−12+1 = 15 = O. 4th to the RIGHT of O: O is position 15; 15+4=19=S. Answer = S. **Short Trick:** 'nth from right' = position from left: 27−n. Then add/subtract as required.

questions.stem: If the English alphabet is reversed (A becomes Z, B becomes Y, C becomes X, ...), what would DESK be coded as?

options.option_text: EHVP (wrong — not a reverse substitution)
WVHP (reverse: D=4→W=23; E=5→V=22; S=19→H=8; K=11→P=16 → WVHP)
WHVP (wrong order of the E and S substitutions)
UVHP (wrong for D: D=4th → reversed = 27-4=23rd letter = W, not U=21st)

questions.explanation: B is correct. Reverse substitution: position n maps to position (27−n). D=4 → 27−4=23=W. E=5 → 27−5=22=V. S=19 → 27−19=8=H. K=11 → 27−11=16=P. Code = WVHP. **Short Trick:** For A↔Z substitution: new position = 27 − old position. Memorise: A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X, D↔W, E↔V, F↔U, G↔T, H↔S, I↔R, J↔Q, K↔P, L↔O, M↔N.
